actorMention.troubleshootHint: Troubleshoot in order, then click "Refresh members":
actorMention.troubleshoot1: 1. Confirm this is bound to the target Feishu group, not a Web session or auto-created session.
actorMention.troubleshoot2: 2. Have group members send a message to the bot in the group; the system discovers members from messages.
actorMention.troubleshoot3: 3. If members are still empty, the bot likely lacks permission to read the group member list.
actorMention.troubleshoot4: 4. Even if empty, you can still manually enter raw mapping text in "Advanced mode".
